integrity: The sufficiency proof establishes HNAp directly for ell_1 via equality in Holder duality. The necessity proof constructs a positive finite-support vector with a strict additivity defect, a positive norming functional, and a signed norm-attaining witness in E direct-sum-one R violating positive-part hereditary norm attainment. Rational examples supplement the analytic argument. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The characterization assumes a real Banach sequence lattice with a finite or countably infinite normalized 1-unconditional Schauder basis and the natural coordinatewise order. It does not address non-atomic lattices or unrestricted ell_infinity. HNAp is distinct from the Bishop-Phelps-Bollobas property for positive functionals.
title: A one-coordinate \(\ell_1\)-sum rigidity theorem for hereditary norm attainment
